Wall-clock deadline observations (deadline_misses 35, mean_update_s 17.075238151415917, control_period_s 0.01) are synchronous scheduler/status observations of the recorded run and are not evidence of physical feedback delay; raw weight magnitudes (terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0, velocity_weight 0.0001, terminal_velocity_weight 0.0001, tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02) do not rank cost-term importance.
